title: An R-loop-related gene signature predicts prognosis and shapes the immune microenvironment in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
snippet: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) features a poor prognosis and unclear pathogenesis, and the role of R-loops, key regulators of genome stability, has not been systematically characterized in this disease. title: Extrachromosomal DNA: A New Therapeutic Frontier for Overcoming Cancer Drug Resistance.
snippet: Extrachromosomal DNAs (ecDNAs) are acentric circular DNA molecules that frequently harbor amplified oncogenes and their regulatory elements. Although ecDNAs occur at low levels in normal cells, oncogenic ecDNAs are enriched in cancer, where they promote tumor evolution, intratumoral heterogeneity, and therapeutic resistance. title: Olink Platform-Based Identification of Peripheral Blood Biomarkers for irAEs in Advanced NSCLC.
snippet: Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Immunotherapy has transformed the treatment landscape for advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). title: Circulating Tumor DNA (ctDNA) for Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) Detection in Colorectal Cancer (CRC): Current Evidence, Clinical Applications, and Future Directions.
snippet: Minimal residual disease (MRD) is a major contributor to colorectal cancer (CRC) recurrence following curative-intent treatment, yet conventional surveillance methods may fail to detect residual disease at its earliest stages.
